verdict.rationale: Chargebee records events and fires configured webhooks on them, and community users confirm multiple webhook URLs per site. Built-in automation exists for dunning, with scheduled payment retries, email reminders and smart retries based on decline type. However, the evidence shows no general user-definable rules or workflow engine, so most event-to-action logic must be built externally behind webhooks. Missing for 10: a native configurable rule/workflow builder for arbitrary event→action automation, documentation of condition-based triggers beyond dunning, and independent hands-on corroboration of automation depth.
